viewerQuestion: These two builds cost the same. What do the numbers on this page actually settle?
viewerTakeaway: I can recognise when a difference on screen is too small for the estimate that produced it to support.

beats.narration: Watch what happens to the difference on this page when the range around it is drawn in.
Every value here arrives with a range. Most comparisons show you the value and hide the range.
On this comparison every per-game difference is smaller than the range SpecSmith's model declares for its own estimates, so the model does not separate them on frame rate. These are model estimates.
beats.onScreenText: The difference does not survive the range

beats.narration: A visible gap on a chart is not the same as a difference the underlying estimate can support.
beats.onScreenText: A visible gap is not a supported difference

beats.narration: Before you use a comparison to choose, look for the range around the number.
